name: B10-0425/2025 (Renew) – Situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Afghanistan: supporting women and communities affected by the recent earthquakes
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for more emergency aid after the August 2025 earthquakes in Kunar and Nangarhar, which killed over 2,200 people and destroyed thousands of homes. It asks the European Commission and member states to keep or increase funding for Afghanistan, urges the Taliban to lift restrictions on women and on aid, and asks Iran and Pakistan to stop deporting Afghans. It is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- More EU emergency aid is requested for earthquake survivors and returning Afghans.
- Afghan women and girls are most affected by Taliban restrictions and aid gaps.
- The Commission and member states decide whether to fund; the Taliban decide on lifting restrictions.
